attempted_claim: Let p be a fixed odd prime, K/Q a fixed quadratic field in which p splits, chi a fixed Hecke character of K with chi|_{A^times}=1, and theta_chi its theta lift to GL_2. Let f be an L^2-normalized Hecke-Maass cuspidal newform of weight 0, trivial nebentypus and fixed Laplace eigenvalue lambda on Y_0(p^n) = Gamma_0(p^n)\H (volume 1), with n -> infinity, and let L(s,f x theta_chi), normalized for s -> 1-s, have finite conductor C ~ p^{2n}. Prove unconditionally |L(1/2,f x theta_chi)| <<_{p,K,chi,lambda,eps} C^{1/4-delta+eps} for some explicit delta>0 (benchmark C^{5/24+eps}), by proving a sub-local sup-norm bound ||f||_infty <<_{lambda,p,eps} p^{n(1/4-delta')+eps} for some explicit delta'>0 on Y_0(p^n) and substituting it into the explicit Waldspurger period formula, via amplified (relative) trace / pre-trace formula with Hu-Saha filtration and quantitative p-adic newvector matrix-coefficient decay plus adelic Whittaker expansion at cusps.
decisive_failure: The blocking analysis rests on standard normalizations (probability measure, fixed arch parameter), the published amplified pre-trace savings range d<=1/12, the volume-heuristic toric scaling, and Casselman newvector peak heuristics encoded in bounded scripts; it does not rule out a fundamentally different proof outside the admitted sup-into-Waldspurger method, nor does it establish any new theorem.
